story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. System Admin detection - Admin Dashboard menu item appears in profile menu for System Admin users 2. Admin Dashboard displays all companies' data (not filtered to admin's companies) 3. Admin Dashboard similar structure to current dashboard with additional "Event Management" tab 4. Event Management tab displays table of all events with filtering by Status and Event Type 5. Reusable React table component library integrated (TanStack Table v8 recommended) 6. Table supports inline editing or field selection with form below for admin record editing 7. Admin can filter pending review events by company, event type, date submitted 8. Admin review interface displays complete event information for review 9. Admin can approve public events with optional comments 10. Admin can reject public events with required feedback comments 11. Event creator receives email notification when event is reviewed (approved or rejected) 12. Approved events automatically become publicly visible (PublicVisibilityDate set) 13. Rejected events remain private with rejection feedback visible to creator 14. Review actions (approve/reject) are logged with admin user ID and timestamp 15. Admin role verification required for all admin endpoints (RBAC) 16. Event Management table shows pending events count and prioritization 17. Admin can view review history for previously reviewed events 18. Event creators can view review status and feedback on their events 19. Comprehensive UAT tests validate all admin dashboard and review workflows

story-context.constraints: - Admin role verification required for all review endpoints (RBAC) - Multi-tenant admin access: Admins see all companies' pending events - PublicReviewStatus must be 'PENDING' to approve/reject - Rejection comments required for reject action - Approved events automatically become publicly visible - Rejected events remain private with feedback visible to creator - All review actions logged with admin user ID and timestamp - Email notifications sent to event creators on review - Review queue load time: < 2 seconds - Event approval/rejection: < 1 second - Email notification delivery: < 5 seconds - Logging: Use enhanced_diagnostic_logs.py to validate all review actions are logged correctly - Maintain Epic 1 performance characteristics - Preserve all existing Epic 1 functionality without breaking changes
